source.publication: 2025 Form CT-1040 Instructions (Rev. 12/25) and Form CT-1040
source.section: PDF pages 8-9, Schedule 1 Line 41; PDF page 24, Social Security Benefit Adjustment Worksheet ('$100,000 or more? Yes: Complete this worksheet', Lines A-F); PDF page 9, Schedule 1 Line 44; PDF pages 19-23, Tax Calculation Schedule Lines 1-10 with Table A, Table B, Tables C-D and Table E; Form CT-1040 Lines 1-6

worked: Federal Social Security Benefits Worksheet: Line 1 benefits 30,000.00; Line 2 half 15,000.00; Line 3 other income 78,000.00; Line 4 tax-exempt interest 0.00; Line 5 = 93,000.00; Line 6 adjustments 0.00; Line 7 = 93,000.00; Line 8 base 32,000.00; Line 9 = 93,000.00 - 32,000.00 = 61,000.00; Line 10 12,000.00; Line 11 = 49,000.00; Line 12 lesser of Lines 9 and 10 = 12,000.00; Line 13 half 6,000.00; Line 14 lesser of Lines 2 and 13 = 6,000.00; Line 15 = 49,000.00 x 0.85 = 41,650.00; Line 16 = 47,650.00; Line 17 = 30,000.00 x 0.85 = 25,500.00; Line 18 taxable benefits, the lesser of Lines 16 and 17 = 25,500.00. Federal AGI = wages 48,000.00 + military retirement pay 30,000.00 + taxable Social Security 25,500.00 = 103,500.00. Federal taxable income = 103,500.00 - 31,500.00 standard deduction - 1 x 1,600.00 age 65+ = 70,400.00 (given, not tested; federal senior deduction ignored). CT-1040 Line 1 federal AGI 103,500.00; Line 2 additions 0.00 (Schedule 1 Lines 31-37: none apply); Line 3 = 103,500.00. Schedule 1 Line 41 Social Security benefit adjustment: federal AGI 103,500.00 is 100,000.00 or more, so ss_full_exempt does not apply (0.00) and the Social Security Benefit Adjustment Worksheet (ss_partial_exempt) is completed: Line A = federal worksheet Line 1 = 30,000.00; Line B = federal worksheet Line 9 = 61,000.00; Line C lesser of A and B = 30,000.00 (Line A); Line D = 30,000.00 x 0.25 = 7,500.00; Line E taxable benefits (federal worksheet Line 18) = 25,500.00; Line F = 25,500.00 - 7,500.00 = 18,000.00 -> 18,000.00. Schedule 1 Line 44 military retirement pay: fully exempt, no income test -> 30,000.00. Schedule 1 Line 50 total subtractions = 48,000.00; CT-1040 Line 4 = 48,000.00. CT-1040 Line 5 Connecticut AGI = 103,500.00 - 48,000.00 = 55,500.00. Tax Calculation Schedule Line 1 = 55,500.00; Line 2 Table A: exemption 16,000.00 at Connecticut AGI 55,500.00; Line 3 taxable income = 55,500.00 - 16,000.00 = 39,500.00. Line 4 Table B (Married Filing Jointly/Qualifying Surviving Spouse schedule) on 39,500.00: 20,000.00 x 0.02 + 19,500.00 x 0.045 = 400.00 + 877.50 = 1,277.50. Line 5 Table C 0.00 (Connecticut AGI 55,500.00 is not more than 100,500.00); Line 6 Table D 0.00 (not more than 210,000.00); Line 7 = 1,277.50. Line 8 Table E decimal 0.10 at Connecticut AGI 55,500.00; Line 9 = 1,277.50 x 0.10 = 127.75. Line 10 Connecticut income tax = 1,277.50 - 127.75 = 1,149.75 (CT-1040 Line 6). No other credits (property tax credit not claimed: no property tax in the inputs, and not modelled). Line A (gross benefits) is the lesser.
